english_text: Honor and glory for all! Victory!
Mind your step! This place is littered with traps!
czech_text: Pozor, kam šlapete! Všude tu jsou pasti!

english_text: Our allies are firing on us!
I claim this base and victory!
czech_text: Beru si tuto základnu i vítězství!

english_text: This area is fortified with Allied traps!
The enemy have lost their commander!
Brave Leonidas has met his end!
Fire harder! Fire further! Damn the engines!
czech_text: Palte silněji! Palte dál! K čertu se stroji!

english_text: The enemy has taken our base!
You are the eyes and ears of the army!
We have slain the enemy commander!
Get those stakes in the ground!
Take care not to get caught in the traps of our allies!
czech_text: Dejte pozor, ať neuvíznete ve spojeneckých pastech!

english_text: Capture the enemy base, or kill all enemy forces!
czech_text: Obsaďte jejich základnu, nebo zničte všechny nepřátele!

english_text: Fight! Fight to the last man!
Join me and the world will be ours!
czech_text: Přidejte se ke mně a svět bude náš!

english_text: Our base is in enemy hands!
czech_text: Naše základna je v rukou nepřítele!

english_text: Apparently our allies see us as fitting targets! Cease fire!
czech_text: Spojenci nás zřejmě mají za vhodné cíle! Zastavit palbu!

english_text: I am the son of Zeus!
Scipio has fought his last battle!
Poor tactics! We are firing on our own allies!
czech_text: Mizerná taktika! Střílíme na vlastní spojence!

english_text: Our allies are caught in our missile fire!
What depraved tactician fires on his allies? Stop!
czech_text: Který zvrhlý taktik střílí na spojence? Dost!

english_text: Spartacus the slave has been killed!
The savage queen has breathed her last!
